359279.candidate: Refutation of arXiv:2307.13161 Conjecture conj:k+4 at k = 8, n = 12 by hooks T1 (row 1 5 7 8 12) and T2 (row 1 2 3 7 10 11)

notes: Source main.tex (lane e-print) Section 2: SYT over [1,n], English convention, rows and columns strictly increasing; T - m deletes cell m, slides the smaller of the right/below neighbours until the hole is an outer corner, then subtracts 1 from entries > m; k-minors are iterated deletions; mM_k is the multiset. The proof of thm: exp lower bound counts n(n-1)...(n-k+1) minors in total, so mM_k counts deletion sequences. A subset reading is not well defined, because relabelling makes the result depend on the order of deletions.

conj:k+4 (Concluding Remarks): Let k >= 1, T in YT(n), n >= k + 4; then mM_k(T) determines T. Lean Conjecture is: for all k n, 1 <= k, k + 4 <= n, for all T U with IsSYT n T, IsSYT n U, minors k T = minors k U -> T = U. This is literal.
IsSYT: nonempty rows, weakly decreasing lengths, strict rows, strict columns via getD (safe, because r'.length <= r.length), flatten is a permutation of range' 1 n. This is literal.

slide/del: the hole reads only (i, j+1) and (i+1, j); the stale value is never read; ties are impossible; it ends with removeCell at the outer corner and relabels x > m to x - 1. This matches the source rule.
Fuel: each slide raises i + j by 1, and i + j <= n - 1, so at most n calls including the final removal. Fuel size T = n therefore suffices for every SYT.
minors sums over entries 1..size T. This is the sequence multiset.

Hook Lemma 1 checked on all words with N <= 9. Lemma 2 formula mM_k(H(w)) = k! sum_P min(P) {H(w|P)} checked on 3,116 cases (exhaustive N <= 8, all k, plus 40 random cases up to N = 13). Lemma 2 proof read: the right-to-left-minimum identity gives sum 2^rlmin = (j+1)! and C(k,j)(k-j)!(j+1)! = k! min P. Correct.

Theorem 3 pigeonhole read: there are 2^N distinct hooks against at most (N C(N,r) + 1)^(2^r) vectors, which is polynomial in N. Correct for every fixed c >= 2. The first hook collision for c = 4 is at n = 12, by exhaustive formula search.
c = 5 pair (k = 11, n = 16) verified directly: distinct, with equal mM_11 (total 174,356,582,400).
Not rechecked (supplementary only): the C-sweep counts for k = 9, 10, 11 at n = k + 4; non-hook collisions first at n = 13; no c = 6 hook collision up to n = 26.

Soundness chain read: den k L = sum of weight * minors k; sum_ins/sum_norm show merging preserves the weighted sum; den_succ unfolds minors (k+1) as a sum over 1-deletions; minors_eq_den uses one_nsmul; chain rewrites; den_perm uses Perm.sum_eq. minors_eq composes eight chain steps per tableau and den_perm 0 hAB. not_conjecture instantiates k = 8, n = 12 with T1_syt, T2_syt, minors_eq and T1_ne_T2. No step is vacuous: den 0 A8 is the literal weighted multiset, and hAB is a Perm of explicit lists.

Fuel exhaustion is excluded in two ways: in general (argument above), and by the A*_ok/B*_ok certificates, which check that every output of del (all of them survive in the merged lists) has size exactly one less and is SYT.

Not a convention or endpoint issue. The refuting pair lies strictly inside the literal domain under the source's own definitions. The failure recurs at n = k + 5 (k = 11), and by Theorem 3 no bound n >= k + c holds for any constant c. This refutes the 'linear k + const' form the source proposes, not just the constant 4.

Not revealed by the source: the source's data stops at k <= 5, and the reviewer sweep shows n = k + 4 is injective for k <= 7. The set version (sibling 359278, threshold k^2 + 2k) has abundant set collisions below its threshold, but that says nothing about multisets.
Not a routine corollary or bridge: no source lemma yields it. The general-c failure needs the hook weight formula, which is new structure, because naive counting over all SYT does not pigeonhole.

Qualifications: (i) the Lean endpoint certifies only the literal k = 8 refutation; Theorem 3 is an ordinary proof only. (ii) The JCTA body is unread. (iii) It is a computer-found counterexample a few steps beyond the authors' verified range, so its weight rests on the conjecture being published (JCTA, restated in 2025 talks) and on the generic hook mechanism.
